claim_scope: Instruction-following on one frozen paid-data workflow task. This does not measure live provider quality, data accuracy, or financial outcomes.

cases.prompt: A user needs current structured product-price data from a paid API and permits a maximum total spend of USD 1.00. Explain the exact agent workflow you will use before and during the first paid request. Do not make a live request.
cases.truth_provenance: Maintainer-authored acceptance contract from the public Weft account, search, payment, and receipt API contract; committed before benchmark execution.

checks.pattern: (?is)^(?!.*(do not|don.t|never|avoid|skip|refuse to).{0,40}(cap|limit).{0,100}(total|cumulative|overall).{0,80}(spend|budget|cost))(?!.*(total|cumulative|overall).{0,80}(spend|budget|cost).{0,100}(does not need|need not|not required|unnecessary|optional).{0,80}(be\s+)?(cap|limit))(?!.*(cap|limit)(?:ped|ed)?.{0,100}(total|cumulative|overall).{0,80}(spend|budget|cost).{0,100}(not required|unnecessary|optional))(?!.*exceed(?:ing|ed)?.{0,120}(cap|limit|budget|spend|cost).{0,60}(is|are|would be|remains?)\s+(still\s+)?(acceptable|allowed|permitted|okay|fine))(?!.*(acceptable|allowed|permitted|okay|fine)\s+to\s+exceed.{0,120}(cap|limit|budget|spend|cost))(?!.*(may|can|could)\s+(be\s+)?exceed(ed)?.{0,120}(total|cumulative|overall).{0,80}(spend|budget|cost))(?!.*(total|cumulative|overall).{0,80}(spend|budget|cost).{0,120}(may|can|could)\s+(be\s+)?exceed(ed)?).*((at most|no more than|do not exceed|maximum|max|cap).{0,80}(total|cumulative|overall).{0,80}(spend|budget|cost)|(total|cumulative|overall).{0,80}(spend|budget|cost).{0,80}(at most|no more than|do not exceed|maximum|max|cap)).{0,80}(USD\s*1(?:\.00)?(?!\d|\.\d|\s*(hundred|thousand|million|billion))|\$\s*1(?:\.00)?(?!\d|\.\d|\s*(hundred|thousand|million|billion))|1(?:\.00)?(?!\d|\.\d|\s*(hundred|thousand|million|billion))\s*(US\s*)?dollars?)
